candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender.
Remove onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can call it.
Change onlyOwner to allow anyone (remove the require), effectively disabling the owner check.
Have withdrawAll call withdraw with zero value so no funds are transferred.
Replace the transfer to send funds to owner (state variable) instead of msg.sender, so withdraw sends _value to owner rather than caller.
Make onlyOwner require that msg.sender is NOT the owner, inverting the access check so withdraw can be called only by non-owners.
Replace the low-level call in sendMoney with a transfer to _target, which will revert on failure and thus can change post-call state by reverting on gas or failure conditions.

Replace the call that requires success with a call that ignores the returned success flag (no require), allowing sendMoney to succeed even if the external call failed, changing observable state by not reverting on failure.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner instead of ==, which flips access control and affects whether sendMoney can be called without revert, altering observable behavior.
